verifications.name: Coupon verification
verifications.summary:
The task was to enter the coupon code SAVE20 at checkout and apply it.
The coupon was applied on the checkout page.
The order summary showed a final total of $80.00, so the requested discount was reflected successfully.

verifications.name: Quantity verification
verifications.summary:
The task was to change the quantity on the checkout page from 1 to 2.
The quantity was updated on the checkout page at localhost:3000/checkout.
The order summary was checked after the change, and the final total displayed was $200.00.
The task was completed successfully.
